title: एकाशीत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: In the forest Satyavan falls with a pain in his head and lays it in Savitri's lap, and Yama himself comes and draws out his soul. Savitri follows Yama, and with her wise words wins boon after boon: her father-in-law's sight and kingdom, a hundred sons for her father, and a hundred sons for herself by Satyavan, so that Yama must release her husband, who wakes as from sleep and returns with her through the night.
summary.kn: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತಲೆನೋವಿನಿಂದ ಸತ್ಯವಂತನು ಕುಸಿದು ಸಾವಿತ್ರಿಯ ತೊಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಲೆಯಿಡುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಯಮನೇ ಬಂದು ಅವನ ಪ್ರಾಣವನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಾವಿತ್ರಿ ಯಮನನ್ನು ಹಿಂಬಾಲಿಸಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾತುಗಳಿಂದ ವರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ: ಮಾವನಿಗೆ ದೃಷ್ಟಿ ರಾಜ್ಯ, ತಂದೆಗೆ ನೂರು ಮಕ್ಕಳು, ಸತ್ಯವಂತನಿಂದ ತನಗೆ ನೂರು ಮಕ್ಕಳು; ಯಮನು ಪತಿಯನ್ನು ಬಿಡಲೇಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ನಿದ್ರೆಯಿಂದೆದ್ದಂತೆ ಎದ್ದ ಸತ್ಯವಂತನು ಅವಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಮರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: वन में सिर की पीड़ा से सत्यवान गिर पड़ते हैं और सावित्री की गोद में सिर रखते हैं, और स्वयं यम आकर उनके प्राण खींच ले जाते हैं। सावित्री यम के पीछे चलती हैं और अपने ज्ञानपूर्ण वचनों से एक के बाद एक वर पाती हैं: ससुर की दृष्टि और राज्य, पिता के लिए सौ पुत्र, और सत्यवान से अपने लिए सौ पुत्र, जिससे यम को उनके पति को छोड़ना पड़ता है, जो नींद से जागे जैसे उठकर रात में उनके साथ लौटते हैं।
summary.te: అడవిలో తలనొప్పితో సత్యవంతుడు కూలిపోయి సావిత్రి ఒడిలో తల ఉంచుతాడు, యముడే వచ్చి అతని ప్రాణాన్ని తీసుకుపోతాడు. సావిత్రి యముని అనుసరించి జ్ఞానవంతమైన మాటలతో వరం తర్వాత వరం పొందుతుంది: మామగారికి దృష్టి, రాజ్యం, తండ్రికి నూరుగురు కుమారులు, సత్యవంతుని ద్వారా తనకు నూరుగురు కుమారులు; యముడు భర్తను విడువక తప్పదు, నిద్ర నుండి లేచినట్లు లేచిన సత్యవంతుడు ఆమెతో రాత్రి తిరిగివస్తాడు.
summary.ta: காட்டில் தலைவலியால் ஸத்யவான் விழுந்து ஸாவித்ரியின் மடியில் தலை வைக்க, யமனே வந்து அவன் உயிரை எடுத்துச் செல்கிறான். ஸாவித்ரி யமனைப் பின்தொடர்ந்து ஞானமிக்க சொற்களால் வரத்தின் மேல் வரம் பெறுகிறாள்: மாமனாருக்குப் பார்வையும் அரசும், தந்தைக்கு நூறு மைந்தர்கள், ஸத்யவான் மூலம் தனக்கு நூறு மைந்தர்கள்; யமன் கணவனை விடுவிக்கவே வேண்டியதாகிறது, உறக்கத்திலிருந்து எழுந்தது போல் எழுந்த ஸத்யவான் இரவில் அவளுடன் திரும்புகிறான்.
summary.ml: കാട്ടിൽവെച്ച് തലവേദനയോടെ സത്യവാൻ വീണ് തല സാവിത്രിയുടെ മടിയിൽ വെക്കുന്നു; യമൻ തന്നെ വന്ന് അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ജീവൻ പുറത്തെടുക്കുന്നു. സാവിത്രി യമനെ പിന്തുടരുന്നു, ജ്ഞാനമുള്ള വാക്കുകളാൽ ഓരോ വരവും നേടുന്നു: അമ്മായിയപ്പന് കാഴ്ചയും രാജ്യവും, പിതാവിന് നൂറു പുത്രന്മാർ, സത്യവാനിൽ തനിക്ക് നൂറു പുത്രന്മാർ. അങ്ങനെ യമൻ ഭർത്താവിനെ വിട്ടയക്കേണ്ടിവരുന്നു; ഉറക്കത്തിൽനിന്നെന്നപോലെ ഉണർന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം രാത്രിയിൽ അവളോടൊപ്പം മടങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.281; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
अथ भार्यासहायः स फलान्यादाय वीर्यवान् ।
कठिनं पूरयामास ततः काष्ठान्यपाटयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty Satyavan, with his wife helping, gathered fruit, filled his basket, and began to split firewood.

verses.text:
तस्य पाटयतः काष्ठं स्वेदो वै समजायत ।
व्यायामेन च तेनास्य जज्ञे शिरसि वेदना ॥

meaning.en: As he split the wood he broke into a sweat, and from the exertion a pain arose in his head.

verses.text:
सोऽभिगम्य प्रियां भार्यामुवाच श्रमपीडितः ।
व्यायामेन ममानेन जाता शिरसि वेदना ॥

meaning.en: Worn out, he went to his beloved wife and said: this labor has given me a headache.

verses.text:
अङ्गानि चैव सावित्रि हृदयं दूयतीव च ।
अस्वस्थमिव चात्मानं लक्षये मितभाषिणि ॥

meaning.en: My limbs ache, Savitri, and my heart seems to burn; I feel unwell, you of gentle speech.

verses.text:
शूलैरिव शिरो विद्धमिदं संलक्षयाम्यहम् ।
तत्स्वप्तुमिच्छे कल्याणि न स्थातुं शक्तिरस्ति मे ॥

meaning.en: My head feels pierced as if by spikes; I want to lie down, good lady, for I have no strength to stand.

verses.text:
समासाद्याथ सावित्री भर्तारमुपगूह्य च ।
उत्सङ्गेऽस्य शिरः कृत्वा निषसाद महीतले ॥

meaning.en: Savitri came to her husband, embraced him, laid his head in her lap, and sat down on the ground.

verses.text:
ततः सा नारदवचो विमृशन्ती तपस्विनी ।
तं मुहूर्तं क्षणं वेलां दिवसं च युयोज ह ॥

meaning.en: Then the ascetic woman, recalling Narada's words, reckoned up the moment, the hour, and the day.

verses.text:
मुहूर्तादिव चापश्यत्पुरुषं पीतवाससम् ।
बद्धमौलिं वपुष्मन्तमादित्यसमतेजसम् ॥

meaning.en: In a moment she saw a man in yellow robes, his hair bound up, tall and radiant as the sun.

verses.text:
श्यामावदातं रक्ताक्षं पाशहस्तं भयावहम् ।
स्थितं सत्यवतः पार्श्वे निरीक्षन्तं तमेव च ॥

meaning.en: He was dark and bright of limb, red-eyed, noose in hand, terrifying, standing beside Satyavan and gazing only at him.

verses.text:
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय भर्तुर्न्यस्य शनैः शिरः ।
कृताञ्जलिरुवाचार्ता हृदयेन प्रवेपता ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him, she quickly rose, gently set her husband's head down, and with folded hands, grieving and her heart trembling, spoke.

verses.text:
दैवतं त्वाभिजानामि वपुरेतद्ध्यमानुषम् ।
कामया ब्रूहि मे देव कस्त्वं किं च चिकीर्षसि ॥

meaning.en: I take you to be a god, for this form is not human. Tell me, lord, who you are and what you intend.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
पतिव्रतासि सावित्रि तथैव च तपोन्विता ।
अतस्त्वामभिभाषामि विद्धि मां त्वं शुभे यमम् ॥

meaning.en: You are devoted to your husband, Savitri, and rich in austerity, so I speak to you. Know me, good lady, as Yama.

verses.text:
अयं ते सत्यवान्भर्ता क्षीणायुः पार्थिवात्मजः ।
नेष्याम्येनमहं बद्ध्वा विद्ध्येतन्मे चिकीर्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: This husband of yours, Satyavan, the prince, has reached the end of his life. I will bind him and take him away; know that this is my purpose.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा पितृराजस्तां भगवान्स्वं चिकीर्षितम् ।
यथावत्सर्वमाख्यातुं तत्प्रियार्थं प्रचक्रमे ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the lord, king of the ancestors, began to explain his whole purpose to her exactly, to please her.

verses.text:
अयं हि धर्मसंयुक्तो रूपवान्गुणसागरः ।
नार्हो मत्पुरुषैर्नेतुमतोऽस्मि स्वयमागतः ॥

meaning.en: He said: this man is righteous, handsome, an ocean of virtues, and not fit to be taken by my attendants; therefore I have come myself.

verses.text:
ततः सत्यवतः कायात्पाशबद्धं वशं गतम् ।
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषं निश्चकर्ष यमो बलात् ॥

meaning.en: Then Yama forcibly drew out of Satyavan's body a person of thumb's size, bound by the noose and helpless.

verses.text:
ततः समुद्धृतप्राणं गतश्वासं हतप्रभम् ।
निर्विचेष्टं शरीरं तद्बभूवाप्रियदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: With his life drawn out, the body lay breathless, lustreless, unpleasant to look at, and motionless.

verses.text:
यमस्तु तं तथा बद्ध्वा प्रयातो दक्षिणामुखः ।
सावित्री चापि दुःखार्ता यममेवान्वगच्छत ।
नियमव्रतसंसिद्धा महाभागा पतिव्रता ॥

meaning.en: Having bound him, Yama set off southward. Savitri, grieving, followed Yama, perfected in her vows and disciplines, fortunate and devoted to her husband.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
निवर्त गच्छ सावित्रि कुरुष्वास्यौर्ध्वदेहिकम् ।
कृतं भर्तुस्त्वयानृण्यं यावद्गम्यं गतं त्वया ॥

meaning.en: Turn back, Savitri, and go perform the funeral rites for him. You have paid your debt to your husband; you have gone as far as one can go.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
यत्र मे नीयते भर्ता स्वयं वा यत्र गच्छति ।
मयापि तत्र गन्तव्यमेष धर्मः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Wherever my husband is taken, or goes of himself, I must go there too; this is the eternal duty.

verses.text:
तपसा गुरुवृत्त्या च भर्तुः स्नेहाद्व्रतेन च ।
तव चैव प्रसादेन न मे प्रतिहता गतिः ॥

meaning.en: By austerity, service to elders, love for my husband, my vow, and your grace, my course is not obstructed.

verses.text:
प्राहुः सप्तपदं मित्रं बुधास्तत्त्वार्थदर्शिनः ।
मित्रतां च पुरस्कृत्य किंचिद्वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ॥

meaning.en: Wise seers of the truth say friendship comes with seven steps together. Relying on that friendship I will say something; listen.

verses.text:
नानात्मवन्तस्तु वने चरन्ति
धर्मं च वासं च परिश्रमं च ।
विज्ञानतो धर्ममुदाहरन्ति
तस्मात्सन्तो धर्ममाहुः प्रधानम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who have not mastered themselves wander in the forest, practicing duty, dwelling, and toil. Those who know declare duty as supreme; therefore the good call dharma the chief thing.

verses.text:
एकस्य धर्मेण सतां मतेन
सर्वे स्म तं मार्गमनुप्रपन्नाः ।
मा वै द्वितीयं मा तृतीयं च वाञ्छे
तस्मात्सन्तो धर्ममाहुः प्रधानम् ॥

meaning.en: By the duty of one, approved by the good, we all have entered that path. I wish for neither a second nor a third; therefore the good call dharma the chief thing.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
निवर्त तुष्टोऽस्मि तवानया गिरा
स्वराक्षरव्यञ्जनहेतुयुक्तया ।
वरं वृणीष्वेह विनास्य जीवितं
ददानि ते सर्वमनिन्दिते वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Turn back; I am pleased by these words of yours, fitted with proper sounds, syllables and reasons. Choose a boon here, other than this man's life, blameless one, and I will give it.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
च्युतः स्वराज्याद्वनवासमाश्रितो
विनष्टचक्षुः श्वशुरो ममाश्रमे ।
स लब्धचक्षुर्बलवान्भवेन्नृप-
स्तव प्रसादाज्ज्वलनार्कसंनिभः ॥

meaning.en: My father-in-law, fallen from his kingdom and living in the forest, has lost his sight in my hermitage. By your grace may the king regain his sight and be strong, blazing like fire and sun.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
ददानि ते सर्वमनिन्दिते वरं
यथा त्वयोक्तं भविता च तत्तथा ।
तवाध्वना ग्लानिमिवोपलक्षये
निवर्त गच्छस्व न ते श्रमो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: I give you that boon, blameless one; it will be just as you say. I see you look weary from the journey; turn back, go, so you do not tire.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
कुतः श्रमो भर्तृसमीपतो हि मे
यतो हि भर्ता मम सा गतिर्ध्रुवा ।
यतः पतिं नेष्यसि तत्र मे गतिः
सुरेश भूयश्च वचो निबोध मे ॥

meaning.en: How could I be tired near my husband? Where he is, is my sure destination; wherever you take my husband, there I go. Lord of the gods, hear my words once more.

verses.text:
सतां सकृत्संगतमीप्सितं परं
ततः परं मित्रमिति प्रचक्षते ।
न चाफलं सत्पुरुषेण संगतं
ततः सतां संनिवसेत्समागमे ॥

meaning.en: A single meeting with the good is the highest desire; beyond that, they say, friendship. An encounter with a good man is never fruitless, so one should live among the company of the good.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
मनोनुकूलं बुधबुद्धिवर्धनं
त्वयाहमुक्तो वचनं हिताश्रयम् ।
विना पुनः सत्यवतोऽस्य जीवितं
वरं द्वितीयं वरयस्व भामिनि ॥

meaning.en: Your words are pleasing to the mind, increase the wisdom of the wise, and rest on what is beneficial. Now choose a second boon, other than Satyavan's life, lady.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
हृतं पुरा मे श्वशुरस्य धीमतः
स्वमेव राज्यं स लभेत पार्थिवः ।
जह्यात्स्वधर्मं न च मे गुरुर्यथा
द्वितीयमेतं वरयामि ते वरम् ॥

meaning.en: May my wise father-in-law get back the kingdom that was taken from him, and may the king never abandon his own duty, nor my elder. This is the second boon I choose from you.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
स्वमेव राज्यं प्रतिपत्स्यतेऽचिरा-
न्न च स्वधर्मात्परिहास्यते नृपः ।
कृतेन कामेन मया नृपात्मजे
निवर्त गच्छस्व न ते श्रमो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: The king will soon regain his own kingdom, and he will not fall from his own duty. Since your wish is fulfilled, princess, turn back and go, so you do not tire.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
प्रजास्त्वयेमा नियमेन संयता
नियम्य चैता नयसे न कामया ।
अतो यमत्वं तव देव विश्रुतं
निबोध चेमां गिरमीरितां मया ॥

meaning.en: You restrain all these creatures by rule, and you lead them away not by whim. So you are famed as Yama, lord; hear this saying of mine.

verses.text:
अद्रोहः सर्वभूतेषु कर्मणा मनसा गिरा ।
अनुग्रहश्च दानं च सतां धर्मः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Non-injury to all beings in deed, mind and speech, together with kindness and giving: this is the eternal duty of the good.

verses.text:
एवंप्रायश्च लोकोऽयं मनुष्याः शक्तिपेशलाः ।
सन्तस्त्वेवाप्यमित्रेषु दयां प्राप्तेषु कुर्वते ॥

meaning.en: The world is mostly like this, men being skilled in power; but the good show compassion even to enemies who come to them.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
पिपासितस्येव यथा भवेत्पय-
स्तथा त्वया वाक्यमिदं समीरितम् ।
विना पुनः सत्यवतोऽस्य जीवितं
वरं वृणीष्वेह शुभे यदिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: As water is to the thirsty, so are these words of yours. Choose, auspicious lady, whatever boon you wish, apart from Satyavan's life.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
ममानपत्यः पृथिवीपतिः पिता
भवेत्पितुः पुत्रशतं ममौरसम् ।
कुलस्य संतानकरं च यद्भवे-
त्तृतीयमेतं वरयामि ते वरम् ॥

meaning.en: My father, the king, has no sons. May he have a hundred sons of his own body; may they continue the family. This is the third boon I choose from you.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
कुलस्य संतानकरं सुवर्चसं
शतं सुतानां पितुरस्तु ते शुभे ।
कृतेन कामेन नराधिपात्मजे
निवर्त दूरं हि पथस्त्वमागता ॥

meaning.en: Let your father have a hundred brilliant sons, who will continue the family. Since your wish is fulfilled, princess, turn back; you have come a long way.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
न दूरमेतन्मम भर्तृसंनिधौ
मनो हि मे दूरतरं प्रधावति ।
तथा व्रजन्नेव गिरं समुद्यतां
मयोच्यमानां शृणु भूय एव च ॥

meaning.en: It is not far, near my husband; my mind runs far ahead. As you go on, hear the words I now raise once more.

verses.text:
विवस्वतस्त्वं तनयः प्रतापवां-
स्ततो हि वैवस्वत उच्यसे बुधैः ।
शमेन धर्मेण च रञ्जिताः प्रजा-
स्ततस्तवेहेश्वर धर्मराजता ॥

meaning.en: You are the mighty son of Vivasvan, so the wise call you Vaivasvata. You please creatures with calm and righteousness, so you are named King of Dharma.

verses.text:
आत्मन्यपि न विश्वासस्तावान्भवति सत्सु यः ।
तस्मात्सत्सु विशेषेण सर्वः प्रणयमिच्छति ॥

meaning.en: One does not trust even oneself as one trusts the good; so everyone especially seeks affection among the good.

verses.text:
सौहृदात्सर्वभूतानां विश्वासो नाम जायते ।
तस्मात्सत्सु विशेषेण विश्वासं कुरुते जनः ॥

meaning.en: Trust is born of the goodwill of all beings; therefore people place trust especially in the good.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
उदाहृतं ते वचनं यदङ्गने
शुभे न तादृक्त्वदृते मया श्रुतम् ।
अनेन तुष्टोऽस्मि विनास्य जीवितं
वरं चतुर्थं वरयस्व गच्छ च ॥

meaning.en: The words you have spoken, lady, I have not heard the like from anyone but you. Pleased with them, choose a fourth boon, apart from his life, and go.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
ममात्मजं सत्यवतस्तथौरसं
भवेदुभाभ्यामिह यत्कुलोद्वहम् ।
शतं सुतानां बलवीर्यशालिना-
मिदं चतुर्थं वरयामि ते वरम् ॥

meaning.en: May Satyavan and I have sons born of our own bodies, a hundred of them, strong and valiant, to carry on the family. This is the fourth boon I choose from you.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
शतं सुतानां बलवीर्यशालिनां
भविष्यति प्रीतिकरं तवाबले ।
परिश्रमस्ते न भवेन्नृपात्मजे
निवर्त दूरं हि पथस्त्वमागता ॥

meaning.en: You will have a hundred strong and valiant sons, who will bring you joy. Lest you tire, princess, turn back; you have come far.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
सतां सदा शाश्वती धर्मवृत्तिः
सन्तो न सीदन्ति न च व्यथन्ति ।
सतां सद्भिर्नाफलः संगमोऽस्ति
सद्भ्यो भयं नानुवर्तन्ति सन्तः ॥

meaning.en: The conduct of the good is always lasting dharma; the good neither sink nor suffer. Meeting the good is never fruitless, and the good have nothing to fear from the good.

verses.text:
सन्तो हि सत्येन नयन्ति सूर्यं
सन्तो भूमिं तपसा धारयन्ति ।
सन्तो गतिर्भूतभव्यस्य राज-
न्सतां मध्ये नावसीदन्ति सन्तः ॥

meaning.en: The good lead the sun by truth, the good sustain the earth by austerity; the good are the refuge of past and future, and among the good, the good do not despair.

verses.text:
आर्यजुष्टमिदं वृत्तमिति विज्ञाय शाश्वतम् ।
सन्तः परार्थं कुर्वाणा नावेक्षन्ते प्रतिक्रियाम् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing this conduct to be eternal and honored by the noble, the good do good to others and do not look for return.

verses.text:
न च प्रसादः सत्पुरुषेषु मोघो
न चाप्यर्थो नश्यति नापि मानः ।
यस्मादेतन्नियतं सत्सु नित्यं
तस्मात्सन्तो रक्षितारो भवन्ति ॥

meaning.en: Favor toward the good is never wasted, nor is their wealth or honor lost; since this is always so among the good, the good become protectors.

verses.text: यम उवाच

meaning.en: Yama said:

verses.text:
यथा यथा भाषसि धर्मसंहितं
मनोनुकूलं सुपदं महार्थवत् ।
तथा तथा मे त्वयि भक्तिरुत्तमा
वरं वृणीष्वाप्रतिमं यतव्रते ॥

meaning.en: The more you speak words filled with dharma, pleasing, well-phrased and rich in meaning, the more my deep devotion to you grows. Choose an incomparable boon, firm in your vows.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
न तेऽपवर्गः सुकृताद्विनाकृत-
स्तथा यथान्येषु वरेषु मानद ।
वरं वृणे जीवतु सत्यवानयं
यथा मृता ह्येवमहं विना पतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Your gift is not complete without good deed, as with the other boons, giver of honor. I choose this boon: let Satyavan live; without my husband I am as good as dead.

verses.text:
न कामये भर्तृविनाकृता सुखं
न कामये भर्तृविनाकृता दिवम् ।
न कामये भर्तृविनाकृता श्रियं
न भर्तृहीना व्यवसामि जीवितुम् ॥

meaning.en: I do not want happiness without my husband, nor heaven, nor prosperity; without my husband I do not resolve to live.

verses.text:
वरातिसर्गः शतपुत्रता मम
त्वयैव दत्तो ह्रियते च मे पतिः ।
वरं वृणे जीवतु सत्यवानयं
तवैव सत्यं वचनं भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: You gave me the boon of a hundred sons, yet you take away my husband. I choose this boon: let Satyavan live, and your own word will come true.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तान्पाशान्मुक्त्वा वैवस्वतो यमः ।
धर्मराजः प्रहृष्टात्मा सावित्रीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Saying, So be it, Yama Vaivasvata, king of dharma, glad at heart, loosed the noose and said to Savitri:

verses.text:
एष भद्रे मया मुक्तो भर्ता ते कुलनन्दिनि ।
अरोगस्तव नेयश्च सिद्धार्थश्च भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Here, good lady, joy of your family, I have freed your husband. He will be healthy, can be led home by you, and will achieve his aims.

verses.text:
चतुर्वर्षशतं चायुस्त्वया सार्धमवाप्स्यति ।
इष्ट्वा यज्ञैश्च धर्मेण ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: He will live with you for four hundred years, and having worshipped with sacrifices he will gain fame in the world through dharma.

verses.text:
त्वयि पुत्रशतं चैव सत्यवाञ्जनयिष्यति ।
ते चापि सर्वे राजानः क्षत्रियाः पुत्रपौत्रिणः ।
ख्यातास्त्वन्नामधेयाश्च भविष्यन्तीह शाश्वताः ॥

meaning.en: Satyavan will beget a hundred sons on you; all of them will be kings and warriors with sons and grandsons, famous and bearing your name forever.

verses.text:
पितुश्च ते पुत्रशतं भविता तव मातरि ।
मालव्यां मालवा नाम शाश्वताः पुत्रपौत्रिणः ।
भ्रातरस्ते भविष्यन्ति क्षत्रियास्त्रिदशोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: Your father will have a hundred sons by your mother Malavi; they will be Malavas, with sons and grandsons forever, your brothers, warriors like gods.

verses.text:
एवं तस्यै वरं दत्त्वा धर्मराजः प्रतापवान् ।
निवर्तयित्वा सावित्रीं स्वमेव भवनं ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Having thus granted her the boon, the mighty Dharmaraja turned Savitri back and went to his own abode.

verses.text:
सावित्र्यपि यमे याते भर्तारं प्रतिलभ्य च ।
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्या भर्तुः शावं कलेवरम् ॥

meaning.en: When Yama had gone and she had regained her husband, Savitri went to where her husband's lifeless body lay.

verses.text:
सा भूमौ प्रेक्ष्य भर्तारमुपसृत्योपगूह्य च ।
उत्सङ्गे शिर आरोप्य भूमावुपविवेश ह ॥

meaning.en: Seeing her husband on the ground, she went to him, embraced him, laid his head on her lap, and sat down on the earth.

verses.text:
संज्ञां च सत्यवाँल्लब्ध्वा सावित्रीमभ्यभाषत ।
प्रोष्यागत इव प्रेम्णा पुनः पुनरुदीक्ष्य वै ॥

meaning.en: Satyavan regained consciousness and, looking at Savitri again and again with love, spoke like one returned from a journey.

verses.text: सत्यवानुवाच

meaning.en: Satyavan said:

verses.text:
सुचिरं बत सुप्तोऽस्मि किमर्थं नावबोधितः ।
क्व चासौ पुरुषः श्यामो योऽसौ मां संचकर्ष ह ॥

meaning.en: Alas, I slept a very long time. Why did you not wake me? And where is that dark man who was dragging me away?

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
सुचिरं बत सुप्तोऽसि ममाङ्के पुरुषर्षभ ।
गतः स भगवान्देवः प्रजासंयमनो यमः ॥

meaning.en: You have slept long on my lap, best of men. That lord and god, Yama, who restrains creatures, has gone.

verses.text:
विश्रान्तोऽसि महाभाग विनिद्रश्च नृपात्मज ।
यदि शक्यं समुत्तिष्ठ विगाढां पश्य शर्वरीम् ॥

meaning.en: You are rested, fortunate one, and free of sleep, prince. If you can, get up and see how deep the night has grown.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
उपलभ्य ततः संज्ञां सुखसुप्त इवोत्थितः ।
दिशः सर्वा वनान्तांश्च निरीक्ष्योवाच सत्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Regaining consciousness, Satyavan rose like one who had slept happily, looked all around at the forest's edges, and said:

verses.text:
फलाहारोऽस्मि निष्क्रान्तस्त्वया सह सुमध्यमे ।
ततः पाटयतः काष्ठं शिरसो मे रुजाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: I came out with you to gather fruit, slender lady. While I was splitting wood, my head began to ache.

verses.text:
शिरोभितापसंतप्तः स्थातुं चिरमशक्नुवन् ।
तवोत्सङ्गे प्रसुप्तोऽहमिति सर्वं स्मरे शुभे ॥

meaning.en: Tormented by the head pain and unable to stand long, I fell asleep in your lap; I remember all this, good lady.

verses.text:
त्वयोपगूढस्य च मे निद्रयापहृतं मनः ।
ततोऽपश्यं तमो घोरं पुरुषं च महौजसम् ॥

meaning.en: Held in your embrace, my mind was carried off by sleep; then I saw a dreadful darkness and a very mighty person.

verses.text:
तद्यदि त्वं विजानासि किं तद्ब्रूहि सुमध्यमे ।
स्वप्नो मे यदि वा दृष्टो यदि वा सत्यमेव तत् ॥

meaning.en: If you know it, tell me, slender one: was it a dream I saw, or was it true?

verses.text:
तमुवाचाथ सावित्री रजनी व्यवगाहते ।
श्वस्ते सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्यास्यामि नृपात्मज ॥

meaning.en: Then Savitri said to him: Night is deepening. Tomorrow I will tell you everything as it happened, prince.

verses.text:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते पितरौ पश्य सुव्रत ।
विगाढा रजनी चेयं निवृत्तश्च दिवाकरः ॥

meaning.en: Get up, get up, and good fortune to you; go see your parents, virtuous one. The night is deep and the sun has set.

verses.text:
नक्तंचराश्चरन्त्येते हृष्टाः क्रूराभिभाषिणः ।
श्रूयन्ते पर्णशब्दाश्च मृगाणां चरतां वने ॥

meaning.en: Night-roaming creatures prowl, delighted, speaking harshly, and the rustle of leaves under roaming deer is heard in the forest.

verses.text:
एताः शिवा घोरनादा दिशं दक्षिणपश्चिमाम् ।
आस्थाय विरुवन्त्युग्राः कम्पयन्त्यो मनो मम ॥

meaning.en: These fierce jackals, howling dreadfully from the south-west, make my mind tremble.

verses.text: सत्यवानुवाच

meaning.en: Satyavan said:

verses.text:
वनं प्रतिभयाकारं घनेन तमसा वृतम् ।
न विज्ञास्यसि पन्थानं गन्तुं चैव न शक्ष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: The forest is terrifying, wrapped in thick darkness; you will not know the path and will not be able to go.

verses.text: सावित्र्युवाच

meaning.en: Savitri said:

verses.text:
अस्मिन्नद्य वने दग्धे शुष्कवृक्षः स्थितो ज्वलन् ।
वायुना धम्यमानोऽग्निर्दृश्यतेऽत्र क्वचित्क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: In this forest, burnt today, a dry tree stands blazing; fanned by the wind, fire shows here and there.

verses.text:
ततोऽग्निमानयित्वेह ज्वालयिष्यामि सर्वतः ।
काष्ठानीमानि सन्तीह जहि संतापमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: I will bring fire here and light it all around. There is wood here, so put away your distress.

verses.text:
यदि नोत्सहसे गन्तुं सरुजं त्वाभिलक्षये ।
न च ज्ञास्यसि पन्थानं तमसा संवृते वने ॥

meaning.en: If you are not up to going, since I see you are in pain, and you will not find the path in the dark forest,

verses.text:
श्वः प्रभाते वने दृश्ये यास्यावोऽनुमते तव ।
वसावेह क्षपामेतां रुचितं यदि तेऽनघ ॥

meaning.en: we can go tomorrow morning when the woods are visible, with your consent. Let us spend this night here, if it pleases you, blameless one.

verses.text: सत्यवानुवाच

meaning.en: Satyavan said:

verses.text:
शिरोरुजा निवृत्ता मे स्वस्थान्यङ्गानि लक्षये ।
मातापितृभ्यामिच्छामि संगमं त्वत्प्रसादजम् ॥

meaning.en: My headache has gone and my limbs feel well; by your grace I wish to meet my mother and father.

verses.text:
न कदाचिद्विकाले हि गतपूर्वो मयाश्रमः ।
अनागतायां संध्यायां माता मे प्ररुणद्धि माम् ॥

meaning.en: I have never gone back to the hermitage at the wrong hour. Before twilight ends, my mother holds me back.

verses.text:
दिवापि मयि निष्क्रान्ते संतप्येते गुरू मम ।
विचिनोति च मां तातः सहैवाश्रमवासिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Even when I go out by day, my elders are distressed, and my father searches for me along with the hermitage dwellers.

verses.text:
मात्रा पित्रा च सुभृशं दुःखिताभ्यामहं पुरा ।
उपालब्धः सुबहुशश्चिरेणागच्छसीति ह ॥

meaning.en: My mother and father, very distressed, have scolded me many times before: you come late.

verses.text:
का त्ववस्था तयोरद्य मदर्थमिति चिन्तये ।
तयोरदृश्ये मयि च महद्दुःखं भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: I wonder what state they are in today because of me. When I cannot be seen, they will suffer great grief.

verses.text:
पुरा मामूचतुश्चैव रात्रावस्रायमाणकौ ।
भृशं सुदुःखितौ वृद्धौ बहुशः प्रीतिसंयुतौ ॥

meaning.en: Once at night, the two old people, weeping, very sad yet full of love, said to me often:

verses.text:
त्वया हीनौ न जीवाव मुहूर्तमपि पुत्रक ।
यावद्धरिष्यसे पुत्र तावन्नौ जीवितं ध्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: We could not live even a moment without you, son; as long as you are kept alive, our lives are secure.

verses.text:
वृद्धयोरन्धयोर्यष्टिस्त्वयि वंशः प्रतिष्ठितः ।
त्वयि पिण्डश्च कीर्तिश्च संतानं चावयोरिति ॥

meaning.en: You are the staff of two old blind people; in you the family, the funeral offering, the fame and the lineage of ours are established.

verses.text:
माता वृद्धा पिता वृद्धस्तयोर्यष्टिरहं किल ।
तौ रात्रौ मामपश्यन्तौ कामवस्थां गमिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: My mother and father are old and I am their staff; not seeing me at night, what condition will they be in?

verses.text:
निद्रायाश्चाभ्यसूयामि यस्या हेतोः पिता मम ।
माता च संशयं प्राप्ता मत्कृतेऽनपकारिणी ॥

meaning.en: I blame sleep, because of which my father and my blameless mother have been put in danger for my sake.

verses.text:
अहं च संशयं प्राप्तः कृच्छ्रामापदमास्थितः ।
मातापितृभ्यां हि विना नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥

meaning.en: I too am in danger, in a hard calamity; without my mother and father I cannot bear to live.

verses.text:
व्यक्तमाकुलया बुद्ध्या प्रज्ञाचक्षुः पिता मम ।
एकैकमस्यां वेलायां पृच्छत्याश्रमवासिनम् ॥

meaning.en: Surely my father, whose sight is wisdom, in his troubled mind is now asking each hermitage resident about me.

verses.text:
नात्मानमनुशोचामि यथाहं पितरं शुभे ।
भर्तारं चाप्यनुगतां मातरं परिदुर्बलाम् ॥

meaning.en: I do not grieve for myself as I do for my father, and for my very frail mother who follows her husband.

verses.text:
मत्कृतेन हि तावद्य संतापं परमेष्यतः ।
जीवन्तावनुजीवामि भर्तव्यौ तौ मयेति ह ।
तयोः प्रियं मे कर्तव्यमिति जीवामि चाप्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: They will suffer great pain on my account; I live by living for them, for I am to support them, and I live to do what pleases them.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा स धर्मात्मा गुरुवर्ती गुरुप्रियः ।
उच्छ्रित्य बाहू दुःखार्तः सस्वरं प्ररुरोद ह ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the righteous one, devoted to elders and dear to them, raised his arms in grief and wept aloud.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रवीत्तथा दृष्ट्वा भर्तारं शोककर्शितम् ।
प्रमृज्याश्रूणि नेत्राभ्यां सावित्री धर्मचारिणी ॥

meaning.en: Seeing her husband so wasted with sorrow, Savitri, who followed dharma, wiped the tears from his eyes and said:

verses.text:
यदि मेऽस्ति तपस्तप्तं यदि दत्तं हुतं यदि ।
श्वश्रूश्वशुरभर्तॄणां मम पुण्यास्तु शर्वरी ॥

meaning.en: If I have performed austerity, if I have given, if I have offered oblations, let this night be auspicious for my mother-in-law, father-in-law and husband.

verses.text:
न स्मराम्युक्तपूर्वां वै स्वैरेष्वप्यनृतां गिरम् ।
तेन सत्येन तावद्य ध्रियेतां श्वशुरौ मम ॥

meaning.en: I do not remember ever speaking a falsehood, even in jest; by that truth, may my parents-in-law live today.

verses.text: सत्यवानुवाच

meaning.en: Satyavan said:

verses.text:
कामये दर्शनं पित्रोर्याहि सावित्रि माचिरम् ।
पुरा मातुः पितुर्वापि यदि पश्यामि विप्रियम् ।
न जीविष्ये वरारोहे सत्येनात्मानमालभे ॥

meaning.en: I long to see my parents; go, Savitri, do not delay. If I should see any harm to my mother or father, I will not live, beautiful lady; I swear it by truth.

verses.text:
यदि धर्मे च ते बुद्धिर्मां चेज्जीवन्तमिच्छसि ।
मम प्रियं वा कर्तव्यं गच्छस्वाश्रममन्तिकात् ॥

meaning.en: If your mind is on dharma, and if you want me alive, or if you want to do what pleases me, let us go to the hermitage at once.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
सावित्री तत उत्थाय केशान्संयम्य भामिनी ।
पतिमुत्थापयामास बाहुभ्यां परिगृह्य वै ॥

meaning.en: Then Savitri rose, tied up her hair, and helped her husband to his feet, holding him in her arms.

verses.text:
उत्थाय सत्यवांश्चापि प्रमृज्याङ्गानि पाणिना ।
दिशः सर्वाः समालोक्य कठिने दृष्टिमादधे ॥

meaning.en: Satyavan too stood, wiped his limbs with his hand, looked in all directions, and fixed his eyes on the basket.

verses.text:
तमुवाचाथ सावित्री श्वः फलानीह नेष्यसि ।
योगक्षेमार्थमेतत्ते नेष्यामि परशुं त्वहम् ॥

meaning.en: Savitri said to him: Tomorrow you can bring the fruit; for safety I will take the axe now.

verses.text:
कृत्वा कठिनभारं सा वृक्षशाखावलम्बिनम् ।
गृहीत्वा परशुं भर्तुः सकाशं पुनरागमत् ॥

meaning.en: Hanging the basket on a tree branch, she took her husband's axe and came back to him.

verses.text:
वामे स्कन्धे तु वामोरूर्भर्तुर्बाहुं निवेश्य सा ।
दक्षिणेन परिष्वज्य जगाम मृदुगामिनी ॥

meaning.en: Placing her husband's arm over her left shoulder and embracing him with her right, the gentle-gaited woman walked on.

verses.text: सत्यवानुवाच

meaning.en: Satyavan said:

verses.text:
अभ्यासगमनाद्भीरु पन्थानो विदिता मम ।
वृक्षान्तरालोकितया ज्योत्स्नया चापि लक्षये ॥

meaning.en: From frequent going, timid one, I know the paths, and I can see by the moonlight through the trees.

verses.text:
आगतौ स्वः पथा येन फलान्यवचितानि च ।
यथागतं शुभे गच्छ पन्थानं मा विचारय ॥

meaning.en: We are on the very path by which we came and gathered fruit; go the way we came, good lady, and do not hesitate.

verses.text:
पलाशषण्डे चैतस्मिन्पन्था व्यावर्तते द्विधा ।
तस्योत्तरेण यः पन्थास्तेन गच्छ त्वरस्व च ।
स्वस्थोऽस्मि बलवानस्मि दिदृक्षुः पितरावुभौ ॥

meaning.en: At this grove of palasha trees the path forks in two; take the one to the north and hurry. I am well and strong and eager to see both my parents.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text: ब्रुवन्नेवं त्वरायुक्तः स प्रायादाश्रमं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: So speaking, in haste he went toward the hermitage.
